The '''''DeepRay''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] stationed aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Dust Dancer]]'' in [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seha Dorvald]] to return [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fost Bramsin]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]]. Unknown to the government figures, the ''DeepRay'' was also used to sneak [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Octa Ramis]] into the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in order to prepare for [[Plan Delta]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] plot to overthrow Natasi Daala.
